name: mirage
text: v1.0.105 is out (NC2): you can bet any NCAAB line by hand (a negative EV only warns), the colored ATS records plus a legend, a moneyline button per team, a hint to the alternate spreads/totals in each game, and early averages for teams with 1-2 games. Early averages appear after the next ncaab-log run. https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.105
